results.title: Multi-Pollutant Emissions Standards for Model Years 2027 ...
results.content: Docket Title | Document ID | Comments || Multi-Pollutant Emissions Standards for Model Years 2027 and Later Light-Duty and Medium-Duty Vehicles | EPA-HQ-OAR-2022-0829-0451 | 246,685 |  |. Under its Clean Air Act authority, the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is proposing new, more stringent emissions standards for criteria pollutants and greenhouse gases (GHG) for light-duty vehicles and Class 2b and 3 (“medium-duty”) vehicles that would phase-in over model years 2027 through 2032. EPA is also proposing new standards to control refueling emissions from incomplete medium-duty vehicles, and battery durability and warranty requirements for light-duty and medium-duty plug-in vehicles. The hearing notice is available at *https://www.epa.gov/​regulations-emissions-vehicles-and-engines/​proposed-rule-multi-pollutant-emissions-standards-model*.
